help.title: How Flow Creates Your Story
help.intro: Flow analyzes your concept and generates a professional film treatment using industry-standard techniques:
help.reasoning: AI Narrative Reasoning—Flow will explain why it chose specific protagonists, themes, and creative directions in the side panel's "Reasoning" tab.
help.threeAct: Three-Act Structure—Your story is automatically organized into Setup, Confrontation, and Resolution beats.
help.characterDev: Character Development—Main and supporting characters with motivations, arcs, and relationships.
help.visualStyle: Visual Style Guide—Tone, mood, and cinematography recommendations tailored to your genre.
help.decisions: The AI may make creative decisions (combining characters, emphasizing themes) to strengthen the narrative—open the side panel's "Reasoning" tab to understand these choices.

welcome.title: Welcome to Blueprint Studio
welcome.description: Blueprint Studio is your creative foundation: Generate → Review → Iterate → Go to Production Studio. One continuous workflow — not scattered editors.
welcome.tip: The sidebar workflow guide and co-pilot show your next step at every stage.

generate.title: Step 1 — Generate
generate.description: Start from a series episode, concept, or imported script. Generate a structured treatment with logline, beats, characters, and tone.
generate.tip: Use Regenerate Blueprint for a full reset; the Assistant for scoped changes.

review.title: Step 2 — Review
review.description: Read each section in the treatment card. Open Audience Resonance in the side panel — save your target audience, then analyze.
review.tip: Audience Resonance target is 80+ before Production.

iterate.title: Step 3 — Iterate
iterate.description: Apply AR recommendations or edit sections directly. Re-analyze after changes to track score improvement.
iterate.tip: Click a category deduction to jump to the matching Blueprint section.

collaborate.title: Collaborate
collaborate.description: Share a collaborate link from the side panel for reviewer feedback, section audio, and structured synthesis.
collaborate.tip: One canonical Collaborate home — the side panel tab.

resonance.title: Audience Resonance strip
resonance.description: The header strip shows your AR score and points to 80+. Use “Improve weakest category” to focus your next edit.

startProduction.title: Step 4 — Start Production
startProduction.description: When your Blueprint is ready, Start Production hands off to script generation and the Production pipeline.
startProduction.tip: A soft gate warns below 80 — you can override with confirmation.
